Each variant = an original profile + listed overrides, or a post-hoc filter (marked APPROXIMATION: dropping a trade after the fact ignores the setups the strategy could have taken instead).

variants.note: same inputs on 15m candles (higher timeframe: wider stops, larger moves per trade)
